summary: Iteration 8 retest of the two fixes flagged in iteration 7. All 10 targeted tests PASS. Activity endpoint now reads from the correct collections (db.saved / db.follows / owner_user_id) and enriches saved items with a `property` snapshot and follows with a `locality` snapshot. AgentEnquiry.agent_id is now Optional in the JSON body, so POST /api/agents/ag-01/enquiries with only {name, mobile, user_id, message} returns 200. No _id leaks anywhere in the activity payload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:730-749 fix looks correct - reads db.saved/db.follows and filters my_listings by owner_user_id, matching the writers at server.py:405-425 and 377.
Property snapshot exposes (id, title, price, images, type, listing_type, address); locality snapshot exposes (id, name, city, image, median_price_per_sq_yd, yoy_change_pct) - matches review request.
Enrichment does per-item find_one() in a loop; fine for demo data (~1-2 items) but consider $lookup or an $in fetch if a user saves hundreds of items.
AgentEnquiry model: agent_id is now Optional(None); path param `aid` is authoritative (server.py:696). Backwards-compatible - still accepts requests that include agent_id in body.
seed_data_creation: One TEST user (mobile 9998887780, name 'TEST Activity') with 1 saved property (p-01), 1 follow (loc-jagatpura), 1 supplier quote (sup-01), and 3 agent enquiries to ag-01. All cleaned up in the module-scope fixture teardown via direct Mongo access (users, saved, follows, quote_requests, agent_enquiries collections).
